evidence_chain.quote: Brachial plexus injury: Perioperative brachial plexus injury is most often linked to positioning that increases plexus tension
The most common referral indication for brachial plexus ultrasound seems to be to exclude brachial plexus pathology in patients with non-specific arm pain and weakness

ranked_facts.why: The fact of decreased sensation in the right arm is supported by the chunk texts, which mention brachial plexus injury and brachial plexopathy as possible causes of arm weakness and sensory complaints.
